title: Manual review of automatically found BASS-II test-ID mentions (evidence_links level auto_unreviewed)
method: Each bare ID mention was read in its page context in the BASS-II Summary Report (NASA/TM-20210011385) and checked against the curated Appendix A row (as-run number, sample number, GMT day of year) and the BASS-II CSV (bass2_tests.gmt_doy, material). Decisions: own_row = the mention is the test's own Appendix A log row (row split across text chunks, so the verified-row link caught only one chunk); figure = a figure caption about this test; cross_reference = the ID is named inside ANOTHER test's notes (link kept, but it is not this test's data).

own_row.label: Appendix A row of this test
